title: Pioglitazone attenuates tamoxifen-induced liver damage in rats via modulating Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1 and SIRT1/Notch1 signaling pathways: In-vivo investigations, and molecular docking analysis.
authors: Kamel, Gellan Alaa Mohamed; Elariny, Hemat A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吡格列酮对大鼠他莫昔芬肝损伤的保护机制，分子对接仅作为辅助验证小分子与蛋白结合，核心为动物实验和信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Tamoxifen (TAM) is a chemotherapeutic drug widely utilized to treat breast cancer. On the other hand, it exerts deleterious cellular effects in clinical applications as an antineoplastic agent, such as liver damage and cirrhosis. TAM-induced hepatic toxicity is mainly attributed to oxidative stress and inflammation. Pioglitazone (PIO), a peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-gamma (PPAR-gamma) agonist, is utilized to treat diabetes mellitus type-2. PIO has been reported to exert anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects in different tissues. This research assessed the impact of PIO against TAM-induced hepatic intoxication. METHODS: Rats received PIO (10 mg/kg) and TAM (45 mg/kg) orally for 10 days. RESULTS: TAM increased aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT), triggered several histopathological alterations, NF-kappaB p65, increased hepatic oxidative stress, and pro-inflammatory cytokines. PIO protects against TAM-induced liver dysfunction, reduced malondialdehyde (MDA), and pro-inflammatory markers along with improved hepatic antioxidants. Moreover, PIO, increased hepatic Bcl-2 expression while reducing Bax expression and caspase-3 levels. In addition, PIO decreased Keap-1, Notch1, and Hes-1 while upregulated HO-1, Nrf2, and SIRT1. Molecular docking showed the binding affinity of PIO for Keap-1, NF-kappaB, and SIRT1. CONCLUSION: PIO mitigated TAM hepatotoxicity by decreasing apoptosis, inflammation, and oxidative stress. The protecting ability of PIO was accompanied by reducing Keap-1 and NF-kappaB and regulating Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1 and Sirt1/Notch1 signaling. A schematic diagram illustrating the protective effect of PIO against TAM hepatotoxicity. PIO prevented TAM-induced liver injury by regulating Nrf2/HO-1 and SIRT1/Notch1 signaling and mitigating oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis.
abstract_zh: 背景：他莫昔芬（Tamoxifen, TAM）是一种广泛用于治疗乳腺癌的化疗药物。另一方面，作为抗肿瘤药物，它在临床应用中会产生有害的细胞效应，如肝损伤和肝硬化。TAM诱导的肝毒性主要归因于氧化应激和炎症。吡格列酮（Pioglitazone, PIO）是一种过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体-γ（peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-gamma, PPAR-gamma）激动剂，用于治疗2型糖尿病。已有报道称PIO在不同组织中发挥抗炎和抗氧化作用。本研究评估了PIO对TAM诱导的肝中毒的影响。方法：大鼠口服给予PIO（10 mg/kg）和TAM（45 mg/kg），持续10天。结果：TAM增加了天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（aspartate aminotransferase, AST）和丙氨酸氨基转移酶（alanine aminotransferase, ALT），引发多种组织病理学改变，NF-kappaB p65，增加肝脏氧化应激和促炎细胞因子。PIO保护免受TAM诱导的肝功能障碍，降低丙二醛（malondialdehyde, MDA）和促炎标志物，同时改善肝脏抗氧化剂。此外，PIO增加肝脏Bcl-2表达，同时降低Bax表达和caspase-3水平。另外，PIO降低Keap-1、Notch1和Hes-1，同时上调HO-1、Nrf2和SIRT1。分子对接显示PIO对Keap-1、NF-kappaB和SIRT1具有结合亲和力。结论：PIO通过减少凋亡、炎症和氧化应激来减轻TAM肝毒性。PIO的保护能力伴随着降低Keap-1和NF-kappaB，并调节Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1和Sirt1/Notch1信号通路。示意图展示了PIO对TAM肝毒性的保护作用。PIO通过调节Nrf2/HO-1和SIRT1/Notch1信号通路，并减轻氧化应激、炎症和凋亡，预防了TAM诱导的肝损伤。
